title: Biju Swasthya Kalyan Yojana (BSKY) Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Odisha government health assurance programme providing cashless treatment and health protection for eligible residents through public and empanelled private facilities.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligibility depends on Odisha's current beneficiary identification and state scheme rules; categories and implementation may change over time.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Biju Swasthya Kalyan Yojana (BSKY).

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
